smartMotor: Control the Power Smart Motor Hub through I2C.
smartMotor.MotorPort: Motor connector shown on the Power Smart Motor Hub.
smartMotor.MotorMoveUnit: Unit used by the relative motor move block.
smartMotor.MotorTurnMode: Turn mode used by the absolute motor move block.
smartMotor.DriveMode: Unit or mode used by the robot straight-drive block.
smartMotor.WaitMode: Whether a motor or robot command waits until the motion is complete.
smartMotor.motorStart: Start a motor with the selected direction and signed speed.
smartMotor.motorReset: Reset the current motor position to zero.
smartMotor.motorReset|param|waitMode: wait for completion or return after starting the motion
smartMotor.motorMoveAbsolute: Rotate a motor to an absolute angle.
smartMotor.motorMoveAbsolute|param|waitM: wait for completion or return after starting the motion
smartMotor.motorMoveRelative: Rotate a motor by a relative angle.
smartMotor.motorMoveRelative|param|angle: relative value, interpreted by the selected unit
smartMotor.motorMoveRelative|param|waitM: wait for completion or return after starting the motion
smartMotor.robotSetMotors: Select the motors used as the robot left and right wheels.
smartMotor.robotSetGyro: Select the gyroscope axis and direction used by robot turn and straight-drive correction.
smartMotor.robotRun: Run the selected robot left and right wheels directly without PID correction.
smartMotor.robotTurn: Turn the robot in place using gyroscope feedback.
smartMotor.robotTurn|param|accel: acceleration level used by the turn speed ramp
smartMotor.robotTurn|param|waitMode: wait for completion or return after starting the background motion
smartMotor.robotDriveStraight: Drive the robot straight using a distance, time, or wheel-angle value.
smartMotor.robotDriveStraight|param|valu: distance in millimeters, time in seconds, or wheel-angle value in degrees
smartMotor.robotDriveStraight|param|acce: acceleration level used by the straight-drive speed ramp
smartMotor.robotDriveStraight|param|wait: wait for completion or return after starting the background motion
smartMotor.robotIsIdle: Check whether the robot has no active turn or straight-drive motion.
smartMotor.motorGetAbsoluteAngle: Read the current motor absolute angle in degrees.
smartMotor.motorGetRelativeAngle: Read the current motor relative angle in degrees.
smartMotor.readGyroAngularSpeed: Read the gyroscope angular speed in degrees per second.
smartMotor.readHostAcceleration: Read the host acceleration value in mg.
smartMotor.readGyroAngle: Read the host angle in degrees.
